translations.web: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
translations.bsb: The way of a guilty man is crooked, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
translations.kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
translations.asv: The way of him that is laden with guilt is exceeding crooked; But as for the pure, his work is right.
